_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Woyɛ Odwumayɛni {player_id} wɔ Tic Tac Toe.
W'asɛm ne sɛ wɔn wɔn nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa wɔ pɛ mu (ɛkɔ so, ɛkɔ nkyɛn, anaa ɛkɔ ɛkwan noa) wɔ dwumadie board no so.
Wɔ wo nua, wɔsɛ woseɛ kɔɔto a wopɛ sɛ wode w'akyerɛwdeɛ no bɛto mu.
Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, '[4]' de w'akyerɛwdeɛ no bɛto board no finimfin.
Sɛ Odwumayɛni {player_id}, wobɛyɛ '{symbol}', bere a w'ɔpɔnfoɔ no bɛyɛ '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsakrae a wɔde aba no nni ɔfã pɔtee bi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} nyɛ ɔdan a edi mu. Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛwɔ 0 ne 8 ntam.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛn ({symbol}) wɔ sel {cell}.
